description: Returns a deep-link URL that opens the map in the user's browser and automatically triggers a PNG download. The user clicks the link, the browser renders the map at full resolution with the legend composited (if legend: true), and the file downloads. There is no server-side rendering; the user's browser is the renderer. Required: map_id. Optional: format (png default), legend (true default).

rationale.description: Optional short label (≤300 chars) for the map edit history, e.g. "add wildfire layer". Omit it to send nothing beyond the tool arguments.

name: export_image
title: Export map as image
